description: Standard humanoid skeleton for every The Spike character. Primary bone names are identical to Godot's SkeletonProfileHumanoid so shared animation can be retargeted with a BoneMap and no renaming. Coordinates are Blender space (Z up, character faces -Y, character's left is +X) for a reference character of height 1.0; the rig builder scales them by the character's proportions.

conventions.rest_pose: A-pose, upper arms 40 degrees below horizontal, elbows bent 8 degrees forward, palms facing the thighs, feet straight, weight neutral
conventions.side_suffix_rule: Primary bones use Left/Right prefixes (Godot humanoid profile). Secondary bones put the side LAST: _L / _R, so Blender's name flipping and X-mirror work.
conventions.twist_bone_policy: Twist bones are deform bones driven by constraints in Blender. Their motion is BAKED into every exported clip (export with force sampling). Godot never drives twist bones itself.

primary_bones.name: Root
primary_bones.note: Floor-projected root. Carries root motion and world placement.

primary_bones.name: Head
primary_bones.note: Pivot at the skull base (atlas), about 73% of a head height below the crown, level with the jaw angle. A pivot at chin level makes nods swing the face; keep it here.

primary_bones.name: Jaw
primary_bones.note: Pivot at the jaw hinge in front of the ear, tail at the chin.

primary_bones.name: LeftEye
primary_bones.note: Eye pivot at the center of the eyeball volume. Gaze is driven in the eye shader (iris offset); the bone is the gaze origin.

mirror_rule: Every bone whose name starts with 'Left' is mirrored to 'Right' with head/tail X negated.

fingers.note: Expanded by the rig builder along the hand axis. base = distance from wrist along the hand axis; lane = offset across the palm (negative = toward the thumb / forward); lengths = proximal, intermediate, distal (or metacarpal, proximal, distal for the thumb).

twist_bones.name: LeftUpperArmTwist
twist_bones.note: Counter-rotates half of the upper arm's twist so the shoulder does not candy-wrap.

twist_bones.name: LeftLowerArmTwist
twist_bones.note: Carries 60% of the hand's twist into the forearm near the wrist.

twist_bones.name: LeftUpperLegTwist
twist_bones.note: Counter-rotates 40% of the thigh twist near the hip.

sockets.name: socket_ball_L
sockets.use: Ball contact point for the left palm (receive, set, block). VFX spawn anchor.

sockets.name: socket_head_top
sockets.use: Above-crown anchor for aura / rarity VFX.

sockets.name: socket_chest
sockets.use: Chest-front anchor for S+ energy accents.

secondary_chain_standard.note: Chains every character may use. Characters declare their actual chains in character.json. Chain roots parent to the listed bone.

standard_cloth_chains.role: Jersey front hem lift on jump and landing
